summary: Woodstox parsing of XML with deeply nested entity references can cause a denial of service
details: AUTHORED FIXTURE - not a copy of any upstream record. Written for TC-7587 to model the unscoped (plain `Maven`) view of CVE-2022-40152, which is the upstream vulnerability that the Red Hat Lightwell woodstox advisories remediate. Simplified to a single affected entry with one open range fixed at the upstream 6.4.0 release, so that the interval alone decides the match: `versions[]` is deliberately absent, because an explicit version list would add a second exact Generic range and mask the interval (see the scenario README).
